name: Sandbox EDU
tagline: Generates hands-on programming project courses with readings, videos, quizzes and an in-browser coding sandbox.
problem: Beginner programming projects online are repetitive (notes apps, tic-tac-toe), and good project-based courses are scarce.
solution: Generates a course for a chosen project with chapters, AI readings, matched videos, quizzes and a final project, plus a hosted code environment, using fast inference and retrieval.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask for a project course and get chapters, quizzes and a live code editor.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Cerebus - Best use of Cerebras” among 85 submissions.
The team shared how each of them learned to code by building.

lessons: Fast-inference sponsors reward experiences that need many generations quickly.
